Karthik / Ben — see guidance below and attached redline.

Summary recommendation:
- Invoice recipient: invoice to Acme Corp (UK entity) at finance@acme-corp.com; billing contact: Lina Ortiz. If they insist on a different legal entity on the PO, we need that exact entity name and VAT ID to match invoicing.
- VAT treatment: allow reverse-charge mechanism on the invoice. We should not gross up. Include lean legal language on the invoice and Order Form appendix: "Where applicable, the supply is treated under the reverse charge mechanism; Acme Corp shall self-account for VAT. Redwood will include Acme's VAT identification number on the invoice on receipt of evidence."
- Evidence required: copy of Acme's VAT registration (VAT ID) and the PO referencing the Order Form number. Retain copy in billing folder for audit.

I've attached OrderForm_v3_redline.docx with the suggested appendix text for the Order Form (billing section) and a short clause for the invoice footer. Ben: if commercial is ok with reverse charge, I'll sign off. If we need to gross up for any markets, escalate.
